deals.evidence: Als neuer Aktionär hat die Freunde des Adlers GmbH 18,55 Prozent der Aktien vom bisherigen Gesellschafter Freunde der Eintracht Frankfurt AG erworben
deals.headline: Freunde des Adlers GmbH buys 18.55% of Eintracht Frankfurt Fußball AG
deals.summary: In April 2018 the AG strengthened its capital base by EUR 15m; in the transaction Freunde des Adlers GmbH (managing shareholder Philip Holzer, with Stephen Orenstein) acquired 18.55% from Freunde der Eintracht Frankfurt AG, which kept 10.00%; e.V. (67.88%) and Wolfgang Steubing AG (3.57%) unchanged. Price for the 18.55% not disclosed.

deals.evidence: Eintracht Frankfurt erhält eine Bürgschaft des Landes Hessen in Höhe von 16 Millionen Euro.
deals.headline: Hesse grants Eintracht Frankfurt a EUR 16m state guarantee
deals.summary: State guarantee from the State of Hesse of EUR 16m supplementing collateral for credit lines during COVID-19; used to secure infrastructure projects, not transfers or personnel.

deals.evidence: injected further equity in the amount of €22 million euro into the company
deals.headline: Eintracht Frankfurt injects EUR 22m of equity; Herzschlag Eintracht GmbH takes 5%
deals.summary: Building on the 2018 structure, the AG took in EUR 22m of further equity; Herzschlag Eintracht GmbH (represented by Sven Janssen) became a 5.00% shareholder. Post-deal: Freunde des Adlers GmbH 16.81%, Freunde der Eintracht Frankfurt AG 7.30%, Wolfgang Steubing AG 3.00%, e.V. 67.89%. The EUR 22m is the total equity injected in the transaction.

deals.evidence: Diese erfolgt durch die Ausgabe von 143.439 neuen Aktien zu einem Preis von jeweils 179,41 Euro.
deals.headline: Eintracht Frankfurt Fußball AG approves EUR 25.7m capital increase
deals.investor: Eintracht Frankfurt e.V. and Gude Eintracht GmbH
deals.summary: Extraordinary general meeting (Monday before the 27 May 2025 release) unanimously approved a capital increase of about EUR 25.7m: 143,439 new shares at EUR 179.41, subscribed by Eintracht Frankfurt e.V. and the newly formed Gude Eintracht GmbH (private individuals close to the club). The share price rests on a Nomura valuation of October 2024 putting equity value at about EUR 503m. Minority shareholders waived subscription rights.

name: Eintracht Frankfurt Fußball AG
notes: Fiscal year ends 30 June; FY 2025/26 figures not yet published (2024/25 were released 30 Oct 2025). Club revenue of EUR 389.1m includes transfer revenue of EUR 118.6m (table: transfers 118.6, media 107.9, sponsorship & marketing 75.8, matchday 57.8, merchandising 23.5, other 5.4); Deloitte Money League 2026 gives EUR 269.9m (22nd) on its basis excluding transfers. Net loss for 2024/25 EUR 8.3m (pre-tax result not separately stated); financial debt EUR 71.8m (gross, not net). Minority stakes (16.81 / 7.30 / 5.00 / 3.00%) are as of April 2021 and were diluted by the 2025 capital increase, in which only the e.V. and Gude Eintracht GmbH subscribed (Gude capped at about 3.73% per the club FAQ); the current split is not published, so stake_pct is null for them. Valuation is the equity value implied by Nomura's October 2024 valuation (not Forbes; Eintracht is not on Forbes' 2026 top 30). Stadium: the Deutsche Bank Park's owning company (Besitzgesellschaft) is Sportpark Stadion Gesellschaft für Projektentwicklung mbH, managed and marketed by Eintracht Frankfurt Stadion GmbH, with Eintracht main tenant since August 2020; whether that company is city-owned is not stated on the page, so stadium_owner is left null. The e.V. lists about 160,000 members. League titles, attendance and social follower counts not captured from a citable page.

ownership_summary: Eintracht Frankfurt e.V., the members' association, holds 67.89% of Eintracht Frankfurt Fußball AG (spun off on 1 July 2000). The minority is held by investor vehicles of private individuals close to the club: Freunde des Adlers GmbH, Freunde der Eintracht Frankfurt AG, Herzschlag Eintracht GmbH, Wolfgang Steubing AG and, since the 2025 capital increase, Gude Eintracht GmbH, whose voting is bound to the e.V.; current minority percentages after the 2025 increase are not published.
